rounds.title: Default dark surface fix
rounds.note: colors.css lists .et-surface--default-dark in both the dark block and the dark-elevated block, so the later dark-elevated values win for it. Cause: tools/scripts/generate-sdk-tokens.mjs:56 maps the elevated surfaces through withValues, which keeps isDefault: true from DARK_ELEVATED_SURFACE (apps/storybook/src/surface-themes.ts:77), so theme-css.ts:106 adds the default-dark selector to the dark-elevated block too. Changes for .et-surface--default-dark: --et-surface-background 38 38 38 -> 23 23 23, --et-surface-color-subtle 115 115 115 -> 135 135 135, --et-surface-elevation 1 -> 0; all other tokens are equal. It then matches .et-surface--dark and the :root dark scheme (already 23). No sdk part, state or the sdk config draws on .et-surface--default-dark (the frame sets .et-surface--dark), so no shot changes today: a) today, b) the selector only in the dark block. A merge of b needs the generator fix afterwards, or yarn sdk:tokens:check fails: in tools/scripts/generate-sdk-tokens.mjs:56 replace "...[LIGHT_ELEVATED_SURFACE, DARK_ELEVATED_SURFACE].map(withValues)," with "...[LIGHT_ELEVATED_SURFACE, DARK_ELEVATED_SURFACE].map((theme) => ({ ...withValues(theme), isDefault: false })),". Pick: b, it is a bug.

a.note: Today: .et-surface--default-dark gets the dark-elevated values (background 38, subtle 115, elevation 1).

b.note: .et-surface--default-dark only in the dark block (background 23, subtle 135, elevation 0), matching .et-surface--dark and the :root dark scheme.
